prompt: Create one isolated illustration: One short closed tubular neck warmer standing loosely upright, open top and bottom visible, soft fabric forming a continuous short cylinder. Contemporary children’s-book illustration, fine neutral charcoal lines, natural proportions and gentle precise shading. Fresh clean modern materials and true-to-life colours. White textiles stay bright white with light cool-gray shadows only. Isolated on pure white with no text, scenery or cast shadows. Show only the requested concept, with its essential identifying details large and readable. No decorative scene, no lettering or card border.
